labels.title: AI Usage
labels.subtitle: Understand your allowance, see what your AI is doing, and follow every unit of usage.
labels.missingRate: This period needs an explicit billing model and a dated tenant rate card. Ask your workspace contact to configure the agreement.
labels.overlappingRates: More than one rate card covers a day in this period. The agreement needs to be reviewed before charges can be shown.
labels.contractChanged: The billing model or allowance changes within this month. Charges need a contract review; usage remains available.
labels.usageStillVisible: Recorded AI activity is still available below. Unavailable charges are not zero charges.
labels.waivedExplanation: These engagements are waived. They do not consume your allowance or generate usage charges.
labels.pendingExplanation: These engagements are not yet included in usage charges or the allowance. Totals may update when processing finishes.
labels.billingExplanation: Included units are applied once across the full workspace month, in calendar-day order. Packs and base charges are calculated per conversation or opportunity per day. Included base-model days cover their additional engagements too. Prices follow the dated agreement; changing a filter does not restart your allowance. These are recorded-usage estimates, excluding the subscription fee.
labels.billingExplanation_pack199: Each pack holds up to N agent runs. For each conversation or opportunity on each day, divide eligible runs by the pack size and round up. For example, 5 runs with a pack size of 4 consume 2 packs. The allowance covers packs; excess packs are multiplied by the pack price. LLM calls and tokens do not change this count.
labels.billingExplanation_extra049: One daily base is one conversation or opportunity with eligible agent runs on one calendar day. The same conversation on two days consumes two bases. Each base includes up to N customer-message runs; runs beyond that limit and all other triggers are extras. The monthly allowance covers entire daily bases, including their extras. Outside the allowance, the charge is the base price plus the unit price of each extra run.
labels.billingExplanation_credit: Each eligible agent run consumes 1 credit, regardless of its trigger. A run may make several LLM calls and invoke several tools; these calls and tokens do not consume separate credits. The allowance covers the first credits of the month. Estimated overage charge = credits outside the allowance × credit price.
labels.invalidDates: Choose dates within the selected month, with the start date on or before the end date.
labels.includedCustomerTurns: customer-message engagements included in the base
labels.clickDay: Select a day to explore its activity
labels.conversationDaysExplanation: Calendar-day metrics count each conversation or opportunity linked to an AI run once per day, regardless of the number of runs, agents or triggers. The same record on different days counts again. Distinct-record metrics count it only once across the entire period. Time zone:
labels.conversationDaysEpisodeDistinction: This differs from conversation episodes, bounded by 24 hours of inactivity or the open/resolved lifecycle according to the account policy.
labels.coverageExplanation: One engagement is one recorded AI run triggered by a message, mention or follow-up. It can use multiple tools and model requests, even without sending a reply. The technical-detail percentage shows how many runs have detailed model-request records; it does not measure AI participation in service sessions. Runs without these details remain included in AI usage totals. Older records may lack these details or precise trigger attribution; unknown data is not treated as zero.
labels.tenantTotalsUnchanged: Allowance cards always show the full workspace month.
labels.name: Name
labels.failureExplanation: Failed runs are included in activity counts and shares, but excluded from charges and the allowance. Only explicit failure outcomes are counted; older records without an outcome are not assumed to have failed.
labels.billingGroupingHint: Group by Conversation or Opportunity to see billing amounts. Shared daily charges are not allocated to triggers, tools, agents, or accounts.
labels.billingHint_waived: This engagement is waived and will not consume your allowance or generate usage charges.
labels.billingHint_pending: This engagement is awaiting processing. It is not yet included in usage charges or the allowance.
labels.billingHint_billed: This conversation/opportunity-day group has estimated usage charges beyond the plan allowance.
labels.billingHint_partiallyBilled: The plan covers part of this daily group's usage; the rest generates estimated charges.
labels.billingHint_included: The plan allowance covers this entire daily billing group, with no extra usage charge.
labels.billingHint_notBilled: This daily billing group has no estimated usage charge at the applicable rates.
labels.billingHint_excluded: This engagement has no billable conversation/opportunity link and is excluded from billing.
labels.billingHint_unavailable: Billing cannot be determined until this period's agreement is configured or reviewed.
labels.billingHint_failed: This run is explicitly marked failed. It is excluded from usage charges and does not consume the plan allowance.
labels.noActivity: No recorded activity matches these filters.
labels.noAccessibleActivity: No accessible engagements match these filters. Workspace totals may include records outside your record permissions.
labels.breakdownExplanation: Actions count engagements using each tool, not invocation counts or confirmed outcomes. Categories can overlap and unique-record totals are non-additive. Charges appear only for complete conversation/opportunity billing groups; shared packs and bases are not allocated to individual actions or agents.
labels.activityExplanation: Failed and waived engagements do not consume the allowance or generate usage charges. Pending engagements are not yet included in the calculation. Other statuses describe the complete conversation/opportunity-day group, not invoice payment status.
labels.detailUnavailable: This engagement is unavailable or your access has changed.
labels.groupExplanation: These amounts belong to the complete day group, including other engagements. They are not an additional charge for this individual action.
labels.legacyTelemetry: Request-level telemetry was not recorded. Available legacy token counters are shown separately; missing counters are unknown.
labels.analyticsIntro: Explore token usage, cache efficiency and performance. Token counts are not customer charges.
labels.tokenChange: Change vs. equivalent period last month
labels.understandTokens: How to read token and cache metrics
labels.analyticsScope: Metrics below cover all runs matching the current filters, across all pages.
labels.tokenAccountingHint: Recorded consumption includes failed, waived and pending runs. Total = input + output; cached input is part of input, and reasoning is part of output. These are token counts, not provider costs or customer charges. Missing counters are unknown (—), not zero; recorded totals may be partial.
labels.cacheAccountingHint: Token cache hit = cached input ÷ input, using runs with both counters. Request cache hit = requests with any cached input ÷ requests reporting usage. Percentages use summed counters, not averages of run percentages; zero denominators are shown as —.
labels.analyticsCoverageHint: Legacy token counters can exist without request telemetry. Token coverage counts runs with input and output counters, not completeness of every request. Request metrics use valid v1 source counters only; unreported requests may have consumed tokens. Averages use only known observations. Duration percentiles use nearest-rank run durations, not model latency. Comparisons use the matching previous-month period, whose telemetry coverage may differ.
labels.sourceAccountingHint: Main includes agent and helper requests; search includes isolated search/knowledge requests. Only requests reporting usage contribute source token counts. The run model labels the run, not necessarily every helper/search model. Unknown source counters are excluded, so source totals may differ from legacy run totals.
